gold: Chronic idiopathic urticaria (CIU) due to methylisothiazolinone contact sensitization

selector.rationale: Chronic urticaria best explains the patient's 2.5-year history of severe urticaria and chronic pruritus, with multiple medication trials providing minimal benefit.

rejected.label: Autoimmune Urticaria
rejected.why: Lack of strong evidence supporting autoimmune cause

rejected.label: Contact Urticaria
rejected.why: Limited evidence, mostly related to contact dermatitis

rejected.label: Contact Dermatitis
rejected.why: Positive skin patch testing, but not the primary diagnosis

rejected.label: Dermal Hypersensitivity
rejected.why: While present, it is not the primary diagnosis, but rather a contributing factor
